# LibreOffice Writer GUI Interface Description

## System and Application Header

- **Application Title Bar**
  - Left: "LibreOffice Writer" icon and text
  - Center: "Untitled 1 - LibreOffice Writer"
  - Right: Window control buttons (minimize, maximize, close)

- **System Information Bar**
  - Top-left: "Activities" label
  - Top-center: Date and time "Oct 22 20:07"
  - Top-right: System icons (including sound, network, and power)

## Desktop Environment Sidebar

- **Left Vertical Dock**
  - Application icons from top to bottom:
    - Google Chrome (browser)
    - Thunderbird (email client)
    - Visual Studio Code (code editor)
    - VLC Media Player (media player)
    - LibreOffice Writer (current application, highlighted)
    - LibreOffice Calc (spreadsheet)
    - LibreOffice Impress (presentation)
    - GIMP (image editor)
    - File Manager (folder icon)
    - Software Center (orange "A" icon)
    - Help (blue question mark)
    - Trash (recycle bin)

## Main Menu Bar

- **Menu Items (Left to Right)**
  - File
  - Edit
  - View
  - Insert
  - Format
  - Styles
  - Table
  - Form
  - Tools
  - Window
  - Help

## File Menu Dropdown

- **File Menu Options**
  - New (with submenu)
    - Text Document (Ctrl+N)
    - Spreadsheet
    - Presentation
    - Drawing
    - Formula
    - HTML Document
    - XML Form Document
    - Labels
    - Business Cards
    - Master Document
    - Templates... (Shift+Ctrl+N)
  - Open... (Ctrl+O)
  - Open Remote...
  - Recent Documents (with submenu)
  - Close
  - Wizards (with submenu)
  - Templates (with submenu)
  - Reload
  - Versions...
  - Save (Ctrl+S)
  - Save As... (Shift+Ctrl+S)
  - Save Remote...
  - Save a Copy...
  - Save All
  - Export... (with submenu)
  - Export As (with submenu)
  - Send (with submenu)
  - Preview in Web Browser (with submenu)
  - Print Preview (Shift+Ctrl+O)
  - Print... (Ctrl+P)
  - Printer Settings...
  - Properties...
  - Digital Signatures (with submenu)
  - Exit LibreOffice (Ctrl+Q)

## Toolbar

- **Formatting Toolbar (Top)**
  - Grid icon
  - Image icon
  - Table icon
  - Text box icon
  - Line icon
  - Page break icon
  - Comment icon
  - List icon
  - More formatting icons

- **Text Formatting Toolbar (Below)**
  - Bold (B)
  - Italic (I)
  - Underline (U)
  - Strikethrough (S)
  - Superscript (A^)
  - Subscript (A_)
  - Font color (A with color dropdown)
  - Highlight color (A with highlight dropdown)
  - Alignment icons (left, center, right, justify)
  - List icons (bulleted, numbered)
  - Indentation icons (increase, decrease)
  - More formatting icons

## Document Area

- **Document Content**
  - Blank white page
  - Page number indicator: "Page 1 of 1"
  - Word count: "0 words, 0 characters"
  - Page style: "Default Page Style"
  - Language: "English (Hong Kong)"

## Status Bar

- **Bottom Status Bar**
  - Left: Page number and word count
  - Center: Page style
  - Right: Language setting and zoom level (100%)

## Sidebar Panel

- **Right Vertical Sidebar**
  - Three horizontal lines (menu button)
  - Icon for drawing tools (pen)
  - Icon for image gallery (purple square)
  - Icon for navigation (blue compass)
  - Icon for document (white page)
  - Icon for text formatting (A with pencil)
  - Vertical scrollbar

## Floating Buttons

- **Top Right Floating Buttons**
  - "Get involved" button
  - "Donate" button
  - Close button (X) for floating buttons

## Document Header

- **Document Title Bar**
  - "Untitled 1 - LibreOffice Writer"

## Document Footer

- **Document Footer Bar**
  - Page number and word count
  - Page style
  - Language setting
  - Zoom level

## Document Margins

- **Document Margins**
  - Top margin: 1 inch
  - Bottom margin: 1 inch
  - Left margin: 1 inch
  - Right margin: 1 inch
